en:
<CLT=cltMIND>So the poison played a role in
this killing game after all...

<CLT=cltMIND>Miu just used it as a diversion,
but next time...

<CLT=cltMIND>...No! There can't be a next time!
I've had enough of this!
<CLT=cltMIND>Case files, lined up for me to read.

<CLT=cltMIND>They contain photographs of murder
scenes and the <CLT=cltSTRONG>tricks the culprits used<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't know if these are real cases,
but they all seem plausible.

<CLT=cltMIND>The first few files have only artist renderings,
but the others have photographs...

<CLT=cltMIND>Is there a reason for that?
Are the old ones <CLT=cltSTRONG>just fictional<CLT=cltMIND>?
